rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality blastocyst consistent with 1DD, noting absent/degenerative ICM and TE and limited expansion/collapse; minor uncertainty around Day 4 blastocyst terminology and some image-specific details like zona pellucida are not fully addressed.

Integrates age, AMH, endometriosis, sperm quality, BMI, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status well, and appropriately frames embryo morphology as the dominant prognostic factor; could more explicitly discuss the unusual Day 4 transfer context.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical context; slight overconfidence in very low probability estimates and some ambiguity around Day 4 developmental expectations prevent a perfect score.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and evidence-based IVF counseling, including caution about PGT-A in low-yield young patients and transfer of the only available embryo; some recommendations are broader than guideline-driven and probability estimates may be more pessimistic than standard counseling.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer counseling and future cycle planning, including endometriosis reassessment, stimulation review, lab review, and uterine evaluation if indicated; useful but not highly specific on protocol modifications or transfer management details.
